EcruteakItemfinderAdventureText:
Ah. You're on an
adventure with your #MON?

Well, what's an
adventure without treasure hunting?

Am I right, or am
I right?
EcruteakItemfinderTrueSpiritText:
Good! You under-
stand the true

spirit of adven-
ture.

I like that! Take
this with you.
ItemfinderExplanationText:
There are many
items lying about

that aren't ob-
vious.

Use ITEMFINDER to
check if there is

an item on the
ground near you.

It doesn't show
the exact spot,

so you'll have to
look yourself.

Oh yeah--I heard
there are items

in ECRUTEAK's
BURNED TOWER.
EcruteakItemfinderToEachHisOwnText:
Oh… To each his
own, I suppose…
EcruteakHistoryBookText:
HISTORY OF
ECRUTEAK

Want to read it?
EcruteakTwoTowersText:
In ECRUTEAK, there
were two towers.

Each tower was the
roost of powerful flying #MON.

But one of the
towers burned to the ground.

The two #MON
haven't been seen since…

Keep reading?
EcruteakThreeMonText:
ECRUTEAK was also
home to three

#MON that raced
around the town.

They were said to
have been born of

water, lightning
and fire.

But they could not
contain their excessive power.

So they say the
three ran like the

wind off into the
grassland.
